mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which in turn leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in a month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rise in unemployment (UNRATE).
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint behavior of INDPRO decrease and UNRATE increase does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.
